remarks: Why rent when you can OWN and BUILD EQUITY? Solid, well-maintained and until just recently, owner-occupied two-family home in "easy" East Norwalk. Just a quick walk to MetroNorth and public transportation - or a slightly longer walk/bike ride to beaches, parks and marinas - this well-located property sits on the corner of Emerson and Burr Place and features a large, flat and sunny side/backyard w room to grow... Each apartment has 2 BRs and 1 full bath. The first floor apartment (1,093 sf) has been freshly painted w. all new carpeting (as seen) and vinyl flooring in the kitchen and dining areas. It also has direct access to the full basement (1,093 sf). The second floor apartment (739 sf) has 2 BRs and 1 full bath, plus plenty of eave storage. Access is either through the common entry foyer or separate exterior stairs to the kitchen. There is a 1-car garage (currently rented by the tenant) as well as paved off-street parking. Whether buying to live or rent there, this is an excellent investment opportunity in a "close to everything" neighborhood including restaurants, shopping, entertainment and highways.
